messages:
Nora (Release): kicking off canary for v2.9.7 -> api-infer at 8% during 13:00-14:00 UTC. primary watches: p99 latency, 5xx, and structured output diffs. release notes: https://release.redwood/v/2.9.7. please monitor closely.
Hector: smoke looks clean from my end. starting prompt-set run for structured responses and rank checks.
deploy-bot: deploy: v2.9.7 -> api-infer started. target=8% started_at=3892345725. status=rolling
Ivy SRE: infra note: setting soft auto-rollback thresholds: 5xx > 1.8% sustained 7m OR p99 +130ms sustained 7m -> auto-rollback. I'll also cap canary pool concurrency to 3 during warmup.
Cal (ML): running relevance + parsing eval now. will post deltas in ~6m.
Sam (Oncall): pegging alert for kv_cache.evictions > 30/min -> page oncall. will watch host churn.
Hector: pinning at 8% while we watch. command: ```bash
redwood route pin --route api-infer --version v2.9.7 --percent 8
```
deploy-bot: routing: api-infer pinned to v2.9.7 at 8% by Hector at 3892345778. note=concurrency=3
Cal (ML): quick heads up: small parse shift on a multi-field output where the final object ordering changed. attaching repro. delta: structured-f1 -1.7% on a small family.
Ivy SRE: infra telemetry shows p99 +95ms and error_rate=1.3% currently. not over thresholds but trending upward on two canary hosts. opening INF-4581.
Nora (Release): let's hold at 8% for 12m. tie-break rule: if by the next check we see p99 +120ms OR structured-f1 <-2.5% sustained 5m, we'll rollback. if marginal, product + ML leads to tie-break. react with :+1: to agree to hold, :no_entry: to rollback now.
Hector: +1 (holding).
Sam (Oncall): paging note: I'm seeing ephemeral connection spikes to canary-1; not yet critical.
Cal (ML): running a narrower tokenization test to see if ordering bump is downstream parser sensitive. will push a variant if needed.
Ivy SRE: monitor update at 3892345940: error_rate=1.5% p99_delta=112ms structured_f1_delta=-2.1% hosts_affected=2 status=held
Nora (Release): thanks. that delta is borderline but under our rollback cut. Sam, Ivy, if infra crosses 1.8% or p99 +130ms for 7m, auto-rollback will kick. Cal please try quick variant. reconvene in 12m for final go/no-go. I'll post to #release-updates after the next snapshot. :hourglass:
